tools.name: shop_vehicles
tools.description: Use for live US cars, SUVs, trucks, EVs, motorcycles, RVs, or trailers by place (near me/close by), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel, features, named dealer, or live-listing recommendation. Call once; never retry/refine/broaden. Geographic fallback is final; filters stay exact. Use

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: For full detail, pass exact shop_vehicles listing_id; returns dealer.dealer_id.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Citation only; never shopping/detail/compare. Search once, then fetch exact IDs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Citation only after search; never shopping/detail. Fetch one exact ID.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Only for explicit comparison: after exactly one shop_vehicles call, pass 2-4 distinct returned listing IDs. Never search or shop again.

tools.name: find_dealerships
tools.description: Use this once to resolve participating dealerships by name/place with IDs, addresses, and listing counts. For named-dealer inventory, pass an exact returned dealer_id to one shop_vehicles call. For rooftop contacts or sales/service hours, call get_dealership once.

tools.name: get_dealership
tools.description: Use this with one exact dealer_id from find_dealerships or get_vehicle to return every public rooftop, phone, website, capability, and named sales/service schedule.

tools.name: schedule_test_drive
tools.description: With explicit consent and confirmation, request dealer test-drive follow-up for this listing.

tools.name: request_trade_in_appraisal
tools.description: With explicit consent and confirmation, request dealer trade-in appraisal for this listing.

tools.name: submit_vehicle_inquiry
tools.description: With explicit consent and confirmation, send this listing's dealer the shopper's question.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

detail: Tool "shop_vehicles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use for live US cars, SUVs, trucks, EVs, motorcycles, RVs, or trailers by place (near me/close by), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel, features, named dealer, or live-listing recommendation. Call once; never retry/refine/broaden. Geographic fallback is final; filters stay exact. Use" → after: "Use for live US/CA cars/SUVs/trucks/EVs/motorcycles/RVs/trailers by place (near me), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel, features, named dealer, or live-listing recommendation.
